cleavage_agent.evidence: For Lys-C/Arg-C digestion, Lys-C proteolysis were carried out with 50mM Tris-HCl (pH 8.0) at 37 °C for 6 h
and then Arg-C digestion was performed overnight with 5 mM DTT, 8.5 mM calcium chloride and 0.5 mM EDTA.
For Lys-C/trypsin digestion, after Lys-C digestion at 37 °C for 6 h, trypsin was added for overnight digestion.
